title: Wristwatch with a smiling face
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- watch band top -->
  <rect x="38" y="4" width="24" height="26" rx="6" fill="#7b4fd4"/>
  <rect x="38" y="4" width="24" height="26" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#a78bfa" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- watch band bottom -->
  <rect x="38" y="70" width="24" height="26" rx="6" fill="#7b4fd4"/>
  <rect x="38" y="70" width="24" height="26" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#a78bfa" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- band holes -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="82" r="2.5" fill="#4c2f94"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="89" r="2.5" fill="#4c2f94"/>
  <!-- buckle -->
  <rect x="60" y="14" width="7" height="10" rx="2" fill="#ffd54a"/>
  <!-- watch body -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="26" fill="#e8553d"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="26" fill="none" stroke="#ff937f" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- watch face -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="20" fill="#fdf6e3"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="20" fill="none" stroke="#ffd54a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <!-- hour markers -->
  <rect x="49" y="32" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#e8553d"/>
  <rect x="49" y="63" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#e8553d"/>
  <rect x="32" y="49" width="5" height="2" rx="1" fill="#e8553d"/>
  <rect x="63" y="49" width="5" height="2" rx="1" fill="#e8553d"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="45" r="2.8" fill="#3d2b1f"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="45" r="2.8" fill="#3d2b1f"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="44" r="0.9" fill="#fdf6e3"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="44" r="0.9" fill="#fdf6e3"/>
  <!-- smiling mouth -->
  <path d="M43 53 Q50 60 57 53" stroke="#3d2b1f" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="51" r="3" fill="#ffb3a7" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="51" r="3" fill="#ffb3a7" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- hands -->
  <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="50" y2="38" stroke="#3d2b1f" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="59" y2="53" stroke="#3d2b1f" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="2" fill="#ffd54a"/>
</svg>
